hn:50428670.name: We Gave AI Coding Agents Production Memory

pitch.subject: UX/UI for the Codela dashboard and product site
pitch.body:
Hi,

Codela's core idea is that agents repeat production mistakes because nobody feeds the failure back to them. That loop is hard to explain in text. It needs to be visible in the product.

I would design the UX/UI for your web app: the key user flows, wireframes and a clickable prototype, before a line of code is written. That includes how a deploy check, a learned incident and a lesson passed to an agent appear on screen.

AR Design specialises in CRM and SaaS dashboards. The work is pixel-perfect and the turnaround is fast.

Reply with a few details on your current stage, or ask for a short call, and I will send a scoped plan.

Rustam | AR Design
pitch.gist_ru: Письмо предлагает основателю Codela спроектировать UX/UI дашборда: ключевые сценарии, вайрфреймы и кликабельный прототип, чтобы наглядно показать ценность «памяти из продакшена» для кодинг-агентов.

pitch.subject: Dashboard UX/UI for VENZX approvals and audit log
pitch.body:
Hi,

VENZX pauses AI agent tool calls until a human approves, and every decision goes into a tamper-evident log. That needs an interface where a reviewer can judge a call in seconds.

I would design the dashboard UX/UI: a clear information hierarchy, KPI cards for allowed, blocked and paused calls, and filterable data tables for approvals, policies and the audit log. You get a responsive Figma kit your developers can build from.

I specialize in CRM and SaaS dashboards. The work is pixel-perfect and the turnaround is fast.

Reply with a few details on your current screens and users, or suggest a short call. I will send a scoped plan.

Rustam | AR Design
pitch.gist_ru: Предлагаю спроектировать UX/UI дашборда для VENZX (согласования, политики, аудит-лог) в виде Figma-кита, и прошу ответить с деталями или созвониться.
